comparison.objective: Lift a scrap sheet off cut parts and place it in a scrap bin.
comparison.physical_skill: Thin-edge pinch, bimanual level lifting, and separation without dragging nested parts.
comparison.success_condition: Sheet reaches the bin while all four cut parts remain on the cutter bed.
comparison.reason: Sheet separation and transport do not test rotary tuning, tool engagement, locking torque, or impact response. No quantitative part-displacement tolerance or specs were provided.
